title: Illustrative free-carrier band model of bulk InGaAsP for the material-gain spectra of Figure 4b
model: Parabolic conduction band and heavy- and light-hole valence bands, k-conserving transitions with the bulk momentum matrix element M_b^2 = m0 E_p/6, exact Fermi-Dirac quasi-Fermi levels (charge neutrality P = N), hyperbolic-secant intraband broadening; no band-gap renormalization or Coulomb enhancement (soa_physics.material_gain)

device.host: bulk InGaAsP lattice-matched to InP, bandgap wavelength about 1.65 um

reference_plane: material (not modal) gain; no confinement factor, no internal loss
notes: Illustrative card: it determines the spectral shape and the band-filling shift of Figure 4b only. It is not used by the device model of card SOA-BULK-REF, whose fitted linear gain a(N - N0) gives 344 1/cm at 1550 nm and 2.58e24 1/m^3 (150 mA); the free-carrier model of this card gives 1097 1/cm there (3.2 times more), a differential gain of 5.6e-20 m^2 (card: 2.5e-20 m^2) and transparency at 1550 nm at 1.39e24 1/m^3 (card N0: 1.2e24); see soa_physics.band_card_consistency. The absolute scale is therefore not used, and Figure 4b is normalized. All values are representative values without a single-device source.

E_g.applies_to: band gap (bandgap wavelength 1653 nm), chosen so that the gain peak lies near 1550 nm at the 150 mA density of card SOA-BULK-REF; band-gap renormalization not modeled

m_e.applies_to: conduction-band effective mass, representative of InGaAs(P) near 1.65 um bandgap wavelength

m_hh.applies_to: heavy-hole effective mass (isotropic average), representative value

source.ref: Vurgaftman, Meyer, Ram-Mohan, J. Appl. Phys. 89, 5815 (2001)
source.locator: Kane energies of the binaries; interpolated value for In0.53Ga0.47As about 25 eV (UNVERIFIED: interpolation and bowing not re-checked)

E_p.applies_to: Kane energy of the bulk momentum matrix element; enters only the absolute scale of the gain

n_r.applies_to: refractive index of the active material at 1.55 um; enters only the absolute scale

broadening_fwhm.applies_to: full width at half maximum of the hyperbolic-secant intraband line shape; equal to the width of a Lorentzian with 0.11 ps intraband relaxation time, but without the Lorentzian tails that produce absorption below the band gap
